stemMd: An isosceles triangle has equal sides of length 13 and base 10. What is its area?
explanationMd: The altitude bisects the base into lengths 5. Its height is the square root of 13 squared−5 squared, or 12. Area is one half times 10 times 12 = 60.

distractorRationale.b: This assumes the height equals the base.
distractorRationale.d: This uses a side as the perpendicular height.
distractorRationale.e: This omits the one-half in the area formula.
